slug: 2025-10-23 Congo relaunches NIU biometric unique-ID card production

facts.fact: The NIU began as a mandatory taxpayer registration for the DGID (Décret 2004-469) and Order 25550 (Oct 2022) makes it mandatory for tax and customs declarations and social-security registration, per the Finance Ministry.

note: The cards are tied to electoral roll revision as a requirement, not stated as keyed on the number.
Reports blank cards and passports obtained from a German partner; a card count is not people enrolled and no operating role is stated.
The op-ed names a planned secure digital identity and a data exchange platform but states no register keyed on the national ID number.

facts.fact: Order 25550 of 12 October 2022 makes the NIU compulsory for registering with the social security funds, among five administrative formalities, and for paying duties at the customs border.
The NIU project coordinator says interfaces are being built between the NIU and the revenue systems ETAX (taxes), SYDONIA (customs) and SIGFIP (budget), with others requested.
